params.body:
`sanity deploy` failed while building: `@sanity/icons` 5 no longer exports the icons from its root, only from one path per icon (`@sanity/icons/Cog`). TypeScript did not catch it, the bundler did.

`structure.ts` now imports the six desk icons from their own paths.

## Checked

- `npx sanity build`: succeeds (it failed with six MISSING_EXPORT errors before).
- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean.
- `npx vitest run`: 11 passed.
params.title: Studio build: import icons from their own paths
